name: IntervU
tagline: Interview practice tailored to your resume and the job, with runnable coding questions, hints and a final report.
problem: Two team members had co-op interviews go badly and had no easy way to practise.
solution: Gemini reads the resume and job description to generate behavioural and coding questions; code runs against test cases in the browser; hints avoid spoilers; feedback and a report follow, with voice.
demo_moment: Team-described: upload a resume, solve a coding question and read the report.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Started from the team's own failed interviews that week.

lessons: A problem the team hit days earlier gives the pitch an honest opening.
